version.changelog:
- 新增支持通过环境变量 IMAGE_DOWNLOAD_DIR 定义图片输出目录，默认仍为原来路径
- README.md、SKILL.md 文档描述相应更新，强调输出目录可自定义
- 其余功能和调用方式不变，兼容老用法

llm.summary: The skill appears to do what it claims (generate cat selfies via Volcengine), but there are metadata/instruction inconsistencies and it executes a script from another skill — verify declared env vars and the called script before installing.

dimensions.detail: Name/description align with image generation. The SKILL.md and code call Volcengine's doubao-seedream model (ARK_API_KEY, MODEL_IMAGE_NAME) and depend on the volcengine-image-generate skill, which is coherent with the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions and the script are scoped to image generation (choose scene, build prompt, call an image-generation script). However the main script uses execSync to run ../../volcengine-image-generate/scripts/image_generate.py — it will execute code from a different skill at runtime, so you should inspect that script because the skill delegates work to an external program.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec (instruction-only plus included JS file). That keeps disk writes limited to the included files and any files created when generating images. No remote downloads or unusual install steps are present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The SKILL.md and README require ARK_API_KEY, MODEL_IMAGE_NAME and optionally IMAGE_DOWNLOAD_DIR to be set in ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json, but the registry metadata declares no required env vars. The requested environment variables are reasonable for image-generation, but the metadata mismatch is an inconsistency that should be resolved before trusting the skill.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and normal autonomous invocation. The skill does not request persistent system-wide configuration changes or modify other skills' configs in the files shown.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is generally coherent for generating images with Volcengine, but before installing: 1) Note the registry metadata lists no env vars while SKILL.md/README require ARK_API_KEY, MODEL_IMAGE_NAME and IMAGE_DOWNLOAD_DIR — make sure you are comfortable providing your Volcengine API key. 2) Inspect the referenced script ../../volcengine-image-generate/scripts/image_generate.py (it will be executed via execSync) to confirm it doesn't exfiltrate secrets or call unexpected endpoints. 3) Ensure the volcengine-image-generate skill is the legitimate implementation you expect. 4) If you plan to allow autonomous invocation, consider the risk that the skill runs another skill's script; require explicit installation and review of that dependency. If you want to reduce risk, run the script manually in a controlled environment and audit the network calls made by the Python image-generation script.
